parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO inbound_events(event_id, phone_number, payload)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS is_new;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Normalize and Validate Event').item.json.event_id, $('Normalize and Validate Event').item.json.phone_number, JSON.stringify($('Normalize and Validate Event').item.json.raw_payload)] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO users(phone_number, full_name)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''))
ON CONFLICT (phone_number) DO UPDATE SET full_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.full_name, ''), users.full_name)
RETURNING *;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Normalize and Validate Event').item.json.phone_number, $('Normalize and Validate Event').item.json.full_name] }}
